title: Single-use T006 focus recovery after #372; pause unapproved T008 without rewriting revalidation evidence

why5.question: Why is T006 still BLOCKED after BS-P1-025 Activation?
why5.answer: PR #372 activated T008 as the sole IN_PROGRESS task although the Human's goal was T006 closure. T001-T005, T006's dependencies, are all CLOSED; T008 is not among T006 blocked_by dependencies.

why5.question: Why cannot task focus be changed by existing safe control transition?
why5.answer: T008's F01/F07 four revalidations remain IN_PROGRESS; existing backlog validator disallows a BLOCKED owning Task, and change-scope disallows bundling validator change with control files. Faking VERIFIED/CLOSED would falsify missing evidence.
why5.evidence_ref: Canonical main validate-backlog.mjs allowedRevalidationTaskStatuses, validate-change-scope.mjs safeControlTransition

why5.question: How is revalidation history preserved?
why5.answer: Do not modify delivery/backlog/QUEUE.json at all. Leave T008's four revalidation claims and prior T007 CLOSED historical record exactly unchanged. Change only T008 status IN_PROGRESS -> BLOCKED (not CLOSED) and T006 BLOCKED -> IN_PROGRESS, plus active_task to T006.
why5.evidence_ref: Current candidate exact four paths and committed QUEUE Git blob 549e733b0de1677be192a0946375bba828c6f05e; CLOSED tasks unchanged

why5.question: Why does this not authorize unrelated governance or product changes?
why5.answer: Change-scope new one-shot escape accepts precisely five file paths including one constitutional docket, exactly base SHA e0018f5, unchanged Build baseline/Sprint manifest/Backlog, byte-identical Task definitions and all other Task states. Validator allows only T008 BLOCKED, with its same four IN_PROGRESS revalidations, while T006 is the active Task at BS-P1-025.
why5.evidence_ref: harness/scripts/validate-change-scope.mjs t006FocusSwitch and validate-backlog.mjs boundedPause; GitHub CI required

why5.question: What is the condition for closing T006?
why5.answer: None of this claims T006 complete: it merely permits T006 to be active. Existing nine mapped Acceptance/Test IDs and Playable App real interaction E2E must pass executable tests, independent BCE, evidence normalization, Human implementation merge and final closure approval. No Worker or deployment automatically starts.
why5.evidence_ref: SP-P1-003 T006 nine acceptance_links, ci/run-product-ci.mjs required active-task tests; GitHub #372 activation and user focus instruction

negative_tests: Wrong base SHA, different changed files, changed Backlog/manifest/Build, another Task/status, modified Task definition or CLOSED evidence all fail one-shot T006 focus gate.
T008 is BLOCKED, its four revalidations stay IN_PROGRESS and cannot be considered VERIFIED/CLOSED.
Constitutional exact digest and direct Human approval required before protected validators may merge.
rollback: Use a new explicitly Human-approved governance PR to return T006 to BLOCKED and T008 to IN_PROGRESS, preserving historical proof. Never rewrite CLOSED records.
